issue.zeroLength: The start and end points coincide, so no wall was created.
issue.duplicateWall: A wall already exists at this location.
issue.selectZone: Select a zone that has not been drawn yet.
issue.zoneTooSmall: A zone must be at least 1 m by 1 m.
issue.wallTooShort: The wall is too short for this opening.
issue.selectFlowPath: Select a flow path in the inspector first.
issue.openingUnbound: The opening is not adjacent to a drawn zone, so a flow path cannot be linked.
issue.selectMatchingWallFlowPath: Select a FlowPath whose endpoints exactly match this opening boundary.
issue.wallFlowAlreadyBound: This opening already has a FlowPath. Unbind it before choosing another.
issue.wallFlowBoundaryUnresolved: This opening is not proven to be a two-Zone interior boundary or a Zone-to-outdoor boundary. Check its wall kind and Zone adjacency.
issue.wallFlowSemanticMismatch: The selected FlowPath endpoints do not match this opening boundary.
issue.wallFlowReadOnly: The read-only SketchPad fact layer cannot receive Studio airflow bindings.
issue.wallFlowBindingInvalid: The wall FlowPath binding was rejected because its identity, boundary, or endpoints are not valid.
issue.rejected: Geometry validation rejected this action; the draft is unchanged.
issue.coordinateInvalid: Enter whole-millimetre coordinates within the supported range.
issue.moveScopeTooLarge: This corner is connected to too much construction for one safe gesture.
issue.moveCollision: The move would place two vertices at the same coordinate; the draft is unchanged.
issue.moveUnavailable: This corner cannot be moved safely in the current construction.
issue.wallMoveUnavailable: This wall cannot be translated while preserving its orthogonal connections.
issue.openingValueInvalid: Enter a valid non-negative whole-millimetre offset and a width greater than zero.
issue.openingOutOfBounds: The opening would extend beyond its host wall; the draft is unchanged.
issue.openingOverlap: The opening would overlap another opening on the same wall; the draft is unchanged.
issue.openingUnavailable: This opening cannot be edited while preserving its host wall and airflow bindings.
issue.wallOverlap: The new wall overlaps existing construction. Extend from an endpoint, or split and trim explicitly.
issue.splitCrossesOpening: The split point crosses a door or window. Split outside the opening span.
issue.splitEndpoint: This wall endpoint is already an explicit junction and does not need another split.
issue.splitVertexExists: A construction vertex already exists here, so no duplicate split was created.
issue.intersectionLimit: This stroke crosses too much construction. Draw it as several shorter wall operations.
issue.topologyUnavailable: The current wall topology cannot complete this operation safely; the draft is unchanged.
issue.trimRejected: This segment still carries a Zone boundary or opening. Remove dependent objects before trimming it.
issue.zoneTargetMissing: Select the semantic Zone to bind to this room first.
issue.zonePartitionSourceMissing: Select the existing room to partition first.
issue.zoneSemanticBound: The selected semantic Zone is already bound to another room.
issue.zonePointOnBoundary: Click inside the room, not on a wall or boundary vertex.
issue.zoneFaceNotFound: No closed room enclosed by real walls exists at this location.
issue.zoneFaceBound: This closed room is already bound to a Zone.
issue.zonePartitionTargetBound: Select another unbound semantic Zone in the navigator for the new room.
issue.zonePartitionOutside: The partition target must be inside the currently selected room.
issue.zonePartitionNotDivided: The current walls do not yet divide this room into two closed areas.
issue.zonePartitionNotBinary: This construction creates zero, three, or more areas. Only an explicit two-room partition is supported.
issue.zoneMergeSame: Select a different adjacent room to merge.
issue.zoneMergeNotAdjacent: The rooms do not share one continuous wall boundary and cannot be merged safely.
issue.zoneMergeOpeningConflict: The shared wall still has an opening. Resolve its opening and airflow bindings first.
issue.zoneFlowPathConflict: This action would change an existing FlowPath Zone endpoint. Unlink the affected flow path first.
issue.zoneMergeSelectSource: The room to keep is selected. Choose Merge again, then click an adjacent room.
issue.zoneTopologyUnavailable: The current wall graph cannot produce this room boundary reliably; the draft is unchanged.
issue.levelCopyTargetNotEmpty: The target Level already contains construction or semantic bindings. Copy is limited to an existing completely empty Level.
issue.levelCopySourceEmpty: The source Level has no wall construction to copy.
issue.levelCopySameLevel: The source and current Level are the same, so nothing was copied.
issue.levelCopyLimit: The source Level exceeds the bounded single-copy construction limit.
issue.levelCopyRejected: The Level construction copy failed complete validation; the current draft is unchanged.
issue.verticalTargetRequired: The current Level has no adjacent target Level for a floor opening.
issue.verticalLevelsNotAdjacent: A floor opening can connect only two adjacent Levels in sorted Level order.
issue.verticalZoneCoverage: The complete opening must lie strictly inside exactly one real closed Zone on each Level.
issue.verticalOverlap: This floor opening overlaps an existing opening between the same Levels.
issue.verticalFlowZoneMismatch: The selected FlowPath endpoints do not match the opening's lower and upper Zones.
issue.verticalFlowAlreadyBound: This floor opening already has one vertical FlowPath binding.
issue.verticalOpeningHasFlowPath: This floor opening still has a vertical FlowPath binding. Unlink it before deleting the construction.
issue.verticalFlowBindingInvalid: The vertical FlowPath binding cannot be created safely. Check object identity and endpoints.
issue.verticalUnavailable: The floor opening cannot be created while preserving Level and Zone semantics.
issue.invalidMove: The moved walls, openings, or Zone failed validation; the draft is unchanged.
issue.underlayUpdateRejected: The underlay settings failed complete geometry validation; the draft is unchanged.
issue.underlayTransformInvalid: Enter whole-millimetre origins, a valid rotation, and opacity from 5 to 100%.
issue.underlayCalibrationInvalid: Choose two distinct points on the underlay and enter their whole-millimetre real distance.
issue.semanticZoneDefinitionInvalid: Enter a unique Zone name. The CONTAM name may contain letters, numbers, dots, hyphens, or underscores and is limited to 15 characters.
issue.semanticZoneVolumeInvalid: Enter a volume from 0.001 to 1000000 m³ with no more than three decimal places.
issue.semanticZoneLevelHeightMissing: This Level has no trusted height, so geometry cannot estimate volume. Enter an explicit volume instead.
issue.semanticAuthoringRejected: The Zone and building geometry could not pass validation as one transaction. The draft is unchanged.
issue.semanticFlowValuesInvalid: Enter a valid flow-element multiplier and relative height.
issue.semanticFlowPathRejected: The Airflow Path, opening, Zone endpoints, and flow element could not pass validation as one transaction. The draft is unchanged.
